name: wan_lr4_camel_s1
hypothesis: Original AMF has a weak useful reference response; a fourfold latent Adam LR increase improves decoded directional control without unacceptable degradation.

evaluation.accept: Useful opposite-direction subject motion with acceptable quality: advance to a separately budgeted independent confirmation.
evaluation.partial: Larger credible separation but both still move left: strength affects response, motion-transfer acceptance still fails.
evaluation.reject: No meaningful improvement or substantial degradation: reject this candidate and stop automatic strength escalation.
evaluation.inconclusive: Unresolved measurement uncertainty or incompatible setup: do not accept or infer scientific failure; identify the precise limitation.
